abilities.description: Abilities are non-magical special actions that use Stamina (short rest resource) or have limited uses. Unlike spells, abilities don't require spellcasting ability and can be used by any calling.

dedication.name: Steady Nerve
dedication.description: You have a well of inner resolve to draw upon. As a bonus action, choose one of the following options: Heal (regain 1d8 + your Dedication level + CON modifier HP), Attack (make one weapon attack), Dash (double movement this turn), Disengage (movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks), or Dodge (attackers have disadvantage until start of your next turn).

options.name: Heal
options.description: Regain 1d8 + Dedication level + CON modifier hit points

options.name: Attack
options.description: Make one weapon attack as part of this bonus action

options.name: Dash
options.description: Double your movement speed for this turn (not yet implemented)

options.name: Disengage
options.description: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks this turn (not yet implemented)

options.name: Dodge
options.description: Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage

dedication.name: Action Surge
dedication.description: You can push yourself beyond normal limits. On your turn, take one additional action. At 17th level, you can use this twice per rest.

dedication.name: Indomitable
dedication.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail. You must use the new roll. You can use this feature twice at 13th level and three times at 17th level.

dedication.name: Flurry of Blows
dedication.description: Immediately after taking the Attack action, spend 1 stamina to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

dedication.name: Patient Defense
dedication.description: Spend 1 stamina to take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

wanderlust.name: Cunning Action
wanderlust.description: You can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

wanderlust.name: Sneak Attack
wanderlust.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage to a creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage or an ally is within 5 feet of the target. Must use finesse or ranged weapon.

wanderlust.name: Uncanny Dodge
wanderlust.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the attack's damage.

wanderlust.name: Bardic Inspiration
wanderlust.description: Grant an ally an inspiration die (d6) they can add to an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw within 10 minutes. Die size increases at higher levels.

scholar.name: Arcane Recovery
scholar.description: During a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your level (rounded up). No slot can be 6th level or higher.

scholar.name: Flash of Genius
scholar.description: When you or an ally within 30 feet makes an ability check or saving throw, use your reaction to add your INT modifier to the roll.

scholar.name: Infuse Item
scholar.description: Imbue mundane items with magic. You know 4 infusion recipes and can have 2 active at a time. Active infusions last until your next long rest.
